w.marca.tagline: We turn ideas into fundable projects
w.hero.descripcion: We help you structure your project, find the right funding calls and arrive at the application fully prepared.
w.hero.panel_texto: It doesn't matter whether you bring just an idea or an already structured project: we analyse whatever you have and show you where its potential lies.
w.hero.opcion1_texto: Answer a few questions and receive your personalised diagnosis.
w.hero.opcion2_texto: Share your document and we analyse your project at no cost.
w.preview.linea3: Fit with the terms of reference
w.problema.titulo: Getting the money isn't the problem.
w.problema.subtitulo: The problem is presenting a project that truly qualifies.
w.cifras.etapas: stages we accompany: idea, structuring, search, fit, adaptation and application
w.que_hacemos.titulo: From an idea to an application
w.que_hacemos.subtitulo: We accompany every stage of the road with method, professionals and digital tools.
w.que_hacemos.nota: Our service runs up to the application. We do not guarantee that funds will be awarded: that decision belongs to each funding body.
w.valor.subtitulo: We combine people, method and technology so your project moves faster and arrives better prepared.
w.valor.rapidez.texto: Your project is formulated and ready to present in far less time. The process is structured and supported with digital tools and artificial intelligence, so you don't spend months putting it together.
w.valor.volumen.texto: You don't depend on a single call. We search and analyse opportunities continuously, so your project has several doors to go through instead of one single bet.
w.valor.personas.texto: The support doesn't end with one submission: depending on the modality you get between three and six months of active search. For Fondo Emprender and for replications the period is one month.
w.mecanismo.titulo: A route to capital that many people still don't use properly
w.mecanismo.texto: The funds exist. What is usually missing is a structured project, aligned with a real opportunity and written in the language the call requires. That is exactly where we work.
w.escalera.titulo: Your road to a funded project
w.escalera.subtitulo: Choose the level that best fits where you are. You can start with the free diagnosis and move forward whenever you want.
w.escalera.nota_legal: The conditions, timelines and price of each modality are detailed at the moment of hiring, along with what is and isn't included. They depend on each call, on the documents required and on the information provided.

w.escalera.mentoria.resumen: We structure your project with you.
w.escalera.replicas.resumen: We take your project to new opportunities.
w.membresias.titulo: Learn and move forward on your own
w.membresias.subtitulo: This is the modality where you take the wheel. We give you the method, the resources and the opportunities; you build the project.
w.membresias.nota: Memberships do not include personalised support or professional fit analysis, unless the commercial conditions expressly say so. Conditions and price are detailed when you create the account.

w.diagnostico.nota: No commitment. You don't need a finished project.

w.diagnostico.no_incluye: The free diagnosis is the doorway: it does not include full structuring, unlimited funding call search or the ideas app.

w.quien.titulo: We build projects with experience, technology and people
w.quien.subtitulo: Behind the platform there is a team and a working network. Technology speeds things up; people decide.
w.quien.nota_alianzas: We work with specialised external structuring professionals and maintain strategic partnerships under development. We only publish the partnerships and logos for which we have express authorisation.
w.replicas.texto: Have you already submitted a project? A replication means identifying whether that project can be adapted to new funding calls, territories or thematic lines. Not every project can be replicated: we check first and, if it applies, we take you to the right portal.
w.faq.q1.p: Do I need a fully structured project?
w.faq.q1.r: No. You can start with just an idea. The free diagnosis works the same way and shows you where you're starting from.
w.faq.q2.p: Can I start with just an idea?
w.faq.q2.r: Yes, and it's the most common starting point. The whole process is designed to take an idea all the way to a formulated project.
w.faq.q3.p: Can I learn to do it myself?
w.faq.q3.r: Yes. The academy and the memberships are designed so you learn the method and apply it on your own.
w.faq.q4.p: Can I do it with support?
w.faq.q4.r: Yes. Mentoring is one month of joint work in which we structure the project with you, not for you.
w.faq.q5.p: Can you structure it for me?
w.faq.q5.r: Yes. Professional structuring is the modality where you delegate the whole process to our team.
w.faq.q6.p: Do you search for funding calls?
w.faq.q6.r: Yes. We identify funding opportunities compatible with your project's characteristics and present them in your panel.
w.faq.q7.p: Can you adapt my project to a funding call?
w.faq.q7.r: Yes. Adaptation adjusts the project to the language, the requirements and the terms of reference of the chosen call.
w.faq.q8.p: Can I replicate a project I already submitted?
w.faq.q8.r: It depends on the project and the call. We first check whether it can be replicated and, if it can, we take you to the Replications Portal.
w.faq.q9.r: Yes, completely, and it creates no further commitment.
w.faq.q10.p: Does the free diagnosis include the structuring?
w.faq.q10.r: No. The diagnosis shows you the potential and the road. Structuring is a separate service.
w.faq.q11.p: Do you guarantee that I will get funding?
w.faq.q11.r: No, and be wary of anyone who promises it: the award is decided by the funding body. Our work goes as far as leaving the project formulated and ready to apply.
w.faq.q12.p: How long does the process take?
w.faq.q12.r: It depends on the call, on the documents required and on how quickly the information is provided. An estimated timeline is defined when you hire the service.
w.faq.q13.r: It varies with the modality and the call. Before hiring you receive the full list of what is required from you.
w.faq.q14.r: No. It is an estimated and conditional timeline: it depends on the call being accepted, on the terms of reference being available and on the complete and timely delivery of the documentation.
